result.description: The QBrain.AI SHALL expose add, list, update, and remove operations for raw-text memories through REST, typed client, MCP stdio, and REPL workflow surfaces.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Add creates a memory and returns ID, text, scope, category, version, and timestamps.
List returns the effective memory set for the active workspace by default.
Update replaces raw text, increments version, and can change scope under validated rules.
Remove soft-deletes a memory by ID.
Invalid IDs, duplicate active IDs, invalid scopes, empty text, and unauthorized scope changes return clear errors.

result.title: Memory CRUD tools
